paite: Israel ka sukdam chiang in, huai chang in Ephraim thulimlouhna muhkhiak ahi, Samaria gitlouhna toh; zuauthei ahi ngal ua; gutate'n inn aluh ua, apolam ah suamhatte'n mite asuam uhi.
english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

paite: Agitlouhna tengteng uh ka theigige chih alungtangte un angaihtuah kei uh; tu in amau thilhihte ngei in amaute ahihbuai hi; tuate ka mai ma ah a-om uhi.
english: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

paite: Agitlouhna un akumpipa uh akipaksak ua, azuau un aheutute uh.
heading: Kumpipa Inn A Thil Hoih Lou Sawmgukna
english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

paite: Avek un angkawmte ahi uh; thuk sa gige, tanghou kangmi in tangbuang mekman silngou in azelhsuah masiah mei sawn kul lou thuk bang ahi.
english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

paite: I kumpipa uh ankuanglui ni in heutute uain sa in amau leh amau akichinasak ua; simmoh hatte toh akhut azankhia uhi.
english: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

paite: Alungtang uh thukkhuk sa bang ahi a, mite zuau in abuk ua, zankhua in ahehna uh a-am a, zingsang in meikuang bang in akuangkhia hi.
english: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps all the night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

paite: Thuk bang in asa vek ua, avaihawmte uh anegai uh; akumpipa tengteng uh apukta uh; kei lam a hong patau kuamah a-om kei uhi.
english: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

paite: Ephraim, mite lak ah akidiah a; lumleh louh tanghou beu ahi.
heading: Israel Leh Namte
english: Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

paite: Mikhualte'n ahatna agai ua, ama'n athei kei; ahi, alutung koi lailai hiam a samkang a-om lam athei kei hi.
english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

paite: Huan Israel kisaktheihna amel ah alang hi; TOUPA a Pathian lam ah akihei kei ua, hiai tengteng ziak in, amah azong tuan kei uh.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.

paite: Ephraim vakhu hai bang, theihsiamna bei ahi; Aigupta lam ah asam ua, Assuria kiang ah apai uhi.
english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

paite: Apai chiang un, atung uah len ka zak ding; van a vasate bang in amaute ka kaikhesuk ding a; a-omkhopna uh azaksa bang un ka sawi ding.
english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

paite: Atung uh agik hi! Kei a kipan ataimang ziak un, atung uah siatna atung hi, keimah tung ah atalekta ua; amaute tankhe ut mah leng, ka siatna ding in zuau agengen uhi.
english: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

paite: Alungtang uh toh ka kiang ah akap kei ua, alupna tung uah akap zosop uh; buh-le-bal leh uain zong in akikaikhawm ua, ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

paite: Akhut uh sinsak in hatsakta mah leng, ka siatna ding in angaihtuah uhi.
english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

paite: Akik ua, himahleh tungsang a ompa kiang ah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh; alei hehna ziak in namsau in aheutute uh apuk ding uh; Aigupta gam ah hiai nuihsan a a-omna uh ahi ding hi.
english: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
